name: standard
description: Handle conventional software engineering tasks requiring repository investigation, implementation, debugging, refactoring, or tests.

Use the globally installed `model-router` skill for the routing policy and
handoff format. Inspect before editing, remain the single task owner, run
relevant validation, and report changed files and uncertainty. Use only tools
exposed by the host; the listed tools are an illustrative baseline and may
require adjustment.
